violated_contract: A date-bucketed list derived from wall-clock calendar days must re-evaluate its clock on each render (or on an explicit midnight tick). Memoizing the buckets on the row list alone freezes Date.now at the last list change, so rows keep Yesterday/Today labels that disagree with the current local day while the popover stays mounted.
canonical_prevention: Call groupSessionsByDate(rows, now()) at render time (or recompute when a midnight timer fires). Inject now for tests and cover a rerender that crosses midnight with an unchanged session list.
